metadata.notes: Every entry below is sourced directly from official .gov statutes, IRS Revenue Procedures, CA BOE Letters to Assessors, CA FTB tax schedules, CA Secretary of State records, or Congressional records.

federal.value: $15,000,000 per individual ($30,000,000 married w/ DSUE); permanent & inflation-indexed per P.L. 119-21 Sec. 70106
$15,480,000 per individual ($30,960,000 married w/ DSUE; +3.20% YoY)

federal.topic: Federal Estate & Gift Top Marginal Rate
federal.value: 40% on taxable transfers exceeding applicable exclusion + $1,000,000 bracket

federal.source_label: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 / Notice in Rev. Proc. 2026-25

federal.topic: IRC § 1014 Step-Up in Basis at Death (incl. CA Community Property 100% Double Step-Up)
federal.value: Basis resets to Fair Market Value at date of death (or 6-month alternate valuation date); 100% step-up on both halves of community property in CA
Up to $250,000 (Single) / $500,000 (MFJ) gain excluded if owned & used 2 of last 5 years (excluding post-1997 depreciation recapture)
0% up to $49,450 Single ($98,900 MFJ); 15% up to $545,500 Single ($613,700 MFJ); 20% above ($16,250 Estates/Trusts)
0% up to $51,050 Single ($102,100 MFJ); 15% up to $563,200 Single ($633,600 MFJ); 20% above ($16,750 Estates/Trusts)
3.8% surtax on investment income/capital gains above $200,000 Single / $250,000 MFJ ($16,000 Trusts 2026)

federal.topic: Federal Trust Compressed Income Tax Thresholds (2026 / 2027)
federal.value: Top 37% ordinary rate hits at $16,000 (2026) / $16,500 (2027) of retained trust taxable income

california.value: Taxed as ordinary income: 1.0% to 12.3% (top bracket >$768,213 Single / >$1,536,426 MFJ in 2026) + 1.0% Mental Health Services Tax >$1,000,000 = 13.3% max

california.value: Conforms to IRC § 1014: inherited property receives FMV basis at date of death for CA income/capital gains tax
california.source_label: CA Legislative Info R&TC § 18031 & FTB Schedule D (540) Instructions

california.source_label: CA BOE Letter to Assessors No. 2026/002

california.value: Factored Base Year Value + $1,044,586 (Feb 16, 2025 – Feb 15, 2027; up 2.15% from $1,022,600 in 2023–25; adjusted biennially by FHFA CA HPI; next Feb 2027)
california.source_label: CA BOE Letter to Assessors No. 2025/009 & Pub. 801

california.topic: Prop 19 Primary Residence, 1-Year Deadline & Multi-Unit Rules
california.value: Transferor AND eligible child must use as principal residence within 1 year; BOE-266 due within 1 year for retroactive relief, BOE-19-P within 3 years. Multi-unit: ONLY the single occupied unit qualifies; rental units are 100% reassessed. LLCs ineligible.
california.source_label: CA BOE Letter to Assessors No. 2026/026 (Aug 3, 2026)

california.value: $7,000 assessed value reduction (~$70–$83/yr tax savings); requires BOE-266 filing
When revocable trust becomes irrevocable on death, successor trustee must serve § 16061.7 notice to heirs/beneficiaries within 60 days (triggers 120-day contest window)

legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Eliminated the scheduled 2026 TCJA cliff (~$7M); set federal estate/gift/GST exclusion to $15,000,000 in 2026, indexed for inflation ($15,480,000 in 2027), and made 10%–37% brackets permanent.

legislative_watch_2025_2026.measure: CA Initiative #1994 (AG #25-0017) — Repeal Prop 19 Family Transfer Rules
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Sought to restore Prop 58/193 unlimited principal residence & $1M non-residence inheritance tax-base transfers; did not appear on qualified Nov 2026 or 2028 ballot lists.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Qualified Ballot Measures

legislative_watch_2025_2026.status: Leading / Unofficial Pass (60.6% Yes as of Nov 9, 2026)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Makes permanent the Prop 30/55 high-income surtax brackets (10.3%, 11.3%, 12.3% + 1% MHSA = 13.3% top) instead of expiring in 2031.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Nov 2026 Election Results

legislative_watch_2025_2026.measure: CA Proposition 40 (One-Time Wealth Tax) vs Proposition 42 (Bans Personal Property Taxes)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.status: Unofficial Nov 9, 2026: Prop 40 Failing (47.2% Yes); Prop 42 Leading (51.6% Yes)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Prop 40 proposed a one-time billionaire wealth tax on individuals/trusts; Prop 42 constitutionally prohibits new state taxes on financial/personal property and retroactive taxes.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Nov 2026 Voter Guide & Results

legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: Would have exempted principal residences of owners aged 60+ from ad valorem property taxes; failed signature qualification.
legislative_watch_2025_2026.source_label: CA Secretary of State Failed/Withdrawn List

legislative_watch_2025_2026.status: Introduced / In Committee (Unlikely in 119th Congress; long-term 2029–2050 legislative risk)
legislative_watch_2025_2026.summary: H.R. 2038 proposes lowering federal estate thresholds, raising rates, and curbing grantor trust step-up; H.Res. 206 affirms preserving IRC § 1014 step-up. Future Congresses before 2040–2050 could revisit estate exemptions or step-up caps.

official_verified.category: SF Rent Ordinance & Rent Board Fee (3-Unit Building)
official_verified.verified_value: Pre-June 13, 1979 3-unit buildings are rent-controlled: allowable annual increase = 1.6% (3/1/26–2/28/27; 1.4% prior year), capped at 60% of Bay Area CPI-U; vacancy decontrol applies on voluntary turnover.
